liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Morning Dew** (3 reviews): Judged one of the best versions heard from this period; The Morning Dew and Rain closing stretch lifted an average show into a memorable one [7][10][12]
- **Eternity** (2 reviews): Closed the first set, according to this correction of another reviewer's memory; Reviewer dislikes it, finding it drags on endlessly [4][13]
- **Box Of Rain** (2 reviews): Opened the second set and led into Iko Iko; At the start of set two, Jerry looked at Phil and shaped a box with his hands, signaling it [4][8]
- **Wang Dang Doodle** (1 review): Reviewer singled it out as a first-set highlight [7]
- **Playing In The Band** (1 review): Reviewer thinks a more electric tone with longer sustain from Jerry would have suited it better [11]

## The recordings

- **gd94-03-17.sbd.ladner.8023.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 18 songs; 139 min; rated 3.53/5 by 17 [1]. Said about its sound: Jerry's vocals sound clear and nuanced on this recording, in fine voice; Vince's grand piano sounds terrific, with some organ throughout the show; Jerry's guitar has a bright, acoustic-like tone for much of the show [9][11][12][13]
- **gd1994-03-17.140066.ots-akg460.ebel.flac1644**: source not stated; 17 songs; 145 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer had front-row seats from GDTS, directly in front of Jerry [3]
- Little St. Patrick's Day stickers were handed out at the show [7]
- Rumors circulated that St. Stephen would appear for St. Patrick's Day; Box of Rain was the nearest thing [10]
- Reviewer saw the first night of the Rosemont run from the 10th row, center, via GDTS [10]
- Jerry's voice was heavily compressed in 1993; reviewer credits Dan Healy's firing before the 1994 tour for the improvement [9]
- Vince is finally fully integrated into the band's sound, in the reviewer's view [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd94-03-17.sbd.ladner.8023.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > DAT > CDR > EAC > SHNv3 [1]. Also: Chain runs soundboard to DAT to CDR, extracted with EAC and encoded to SHN; Transferred by neolevo; seeded via candyman and also to abgd via Charlie Connor [1]
- **gd1994-03-17.140066.ots-akg460.ebel.flac1644**: transferred by Pete Ebel; source: flac16/44 Source Info:TS AKG 460->DATTransfer Info:DAT (Panasonic SV-3700) -> Coxial SPDIF-> Marantz PMD 661 MKII (Solid State Recorder)->SD Card-> Wav-> Flac… [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1994-03-17 Rosemont Horizon, Rosemont, IL, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1994-03-17-rosemont-horizon-rosemont-il-usa/) [16]
